Diagnose stability of overall tumbling mode weights under perturbation

Source: R/ke.R
dxyz_dunit_to_overall_modes_stability.Rd

Diagnose stability of overall tumbling mode weights under perturbation

Usage

dxyz_dunit_to_overall_modes_stability(
  dxyz_vec,
  dunit_matrix,
  perturb_sd,
  n_rep = 100L,
  tol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
)

Arguments

dxyz_vec

numeric vector with diffusion tensor principal values c(Dx, Dy, Dz)

dunit_matrix

matrix (pairs, 5) of unit dipole-dipole tensor averages in the diffusion frame

perturb_sd

standard deviation of additive Gaussian perturbations

n_rep

integer number of perturbation replicates

tol

numeric tolerance passed to dxyz_dunit_to_overall_modes()

Value

List summarizing the stability of a_overall_matrix under repeated perturbation of dunit_matrix.
